if-the-player-has-less-than-60-shayzien-.npc: Don't expect me to deal with the likes of you.

if-the-player-has-less-than-60-shayzien-.text: You do not have enough Shayzien favour. Current favour: [current favour in %] - Required: 60.0%

if-the-player-has-less-than-60-shayzien-.npc: If you're planning on fighting me for a set of my armour, I'm afraid I'm not interested. The combat XP from fighting you isn't worthwhile. Get a Defence level of 20 first.

if-the-player-has-60-shayzien-favour-and.npc: Hello. Do you fancy a fight? It's just a bit of fun, so I can practice melee combat. I'll give you a piece of my armour if you win.

options.text: Okay, I reckon I can take you.

steps.player: Okay, I reckon I can take you. Did you just say you wanted to practice melee combat in particular?

steps.npc: Yes, I'm not interested in fancy magicks. We leave that namby-pamby stuff to the Arceuus weirdos. And no ranging either. We'll fight just with melee.
Remember, if you lose, you'll probably drop some items, and you probably won't get them back again. Just run away if you want to stop the fight.

options.text: Let's forget about fighting for now.

steps.player: Let's forget about fighting for now.

steps.npc: In that case you probably shouldn't be hanging around an army camp.
Let me know if you change your mind. I need combat practice if I'm ever going to level up.

if-the-player-does-not-have-the-full-set.npc: Fancy another fight? The combat practice is good for me. I'll give you some more of my armour if you win.

steps.npc: Let me know if you change your mind. The combat practice is good for me.

if-the-player-has-the-full-set-of-tier-1.npc: Don't you already have a set of my armour?

options.text: Let's fight again - I don't mind duplicates.

steps.player: Let's fight again - I don't mind duplicates.

options.text: Okay, I guess I needn't fight you again.

steps.player: Okay, I guess I needn't fight you again.

steps.npc: I'll be here if you ever change your mind.
